about.heroSubtitle: Investment opportunities in Budapest's most prestigious areas with 15 years of experience
about.description1: Aszena Invest is an investment company headquartered in Budapest, the capital of Hungary, specializing in real estate investment, project development and acquisition processes.
about.description2: Operating since 2010, Aszena Invest has developed selected projects in the right locations in Hungary's most prestigious areas throughout its 15-year professional history.
about.description3: Today, Aszena Invest offers reliable, profitable and sustainable opportunities to business partners and potential investors with ongoing and completed projects in important locations in Hungary, especially Budapest.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To be an international investment company that brings together capital and business partnerships from Türkiye and the Middle East with investment opportunities in Hungary and Croatia, offering reliable, transparent, and sustainable solutions.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: Aszena Invest's mission is to identify "off-market" real estate opportunities and rare values that are not easily accessible to everyone. In every project, our priority is to create lasting value, provide long-term gains, and establish trust and transparency to international standards.

projectDevelopment.title: Project Development
projectDevelopment.subtitle: We develop prestigious projects from scratch
projectDevelopment.description: Aszena Invest carefully plans and implements every stage of the project development process. We manage all processes from proper location selection to project completion with a professional approach.

overview.p1: For any designated plot or property, we meticulously execute feasibility studies, design processes, and manage relations with local authorities. We specialize in expediting permitting procedures and assessing privileged investment opportunities that can provide project‑specific advantages.
overview.p2: Aszena Invest generally does not engage directly in construction; instead, we undertake the sale and investor presentation of the projects we develop. Our projects are primarily positioned in tourism, commercial, mixed‑use, and residential sectors.
overview.p3: Our target market includes investors and partnerships in Türkiye and the Middle East, as well as strategic collaborations within the Hungarian domestic market.

development.title: Project Development
development.subtitle: Our Core Principle
development.description: For Aszena Invest, the most critical step in the project development process is finding the right opportunity in the right location. Our company stands out with its ability to identify "off-market" real estate opportunities that are often not publicly available, or rare values that not everyone can easily access.

agriculture.title: Agriculture and Forest Investments
agriculture.subtitle: Ecological Farming of the Future
agriculture.description: In light of global developments in recent years, the significance of future agriculture has been emphasized, with ecological and organic farming taking center stage. In Hungary, we conduct ecological farming operations including alfalfa and wheat production across 4.5 million square meters of agricultural land that we co-own and is under our proprietary rights. Through the implementation of modern technologies and sustainable agricultural practices, we simultaneously protect the environment while producing high-quality organic products. Additionally, on our 150,000 m² forest property, we engage in professional forest management and tree cultivation activities. By employing environmentally conscious forest management practices, we maintain sustainable forestry operations and produce quality timber while preserving the natural ecosystem. Within this domain, we generate economic value and promote biodiversity through the application of modern forestry techniques that respect nature's delicate balance. Guided by sustainable forest management principles, we continue our endeavors with the objective of bequeathing a greener and healthier environment to future generations.
